violations.explanation: The selected category is indicated only visually (triangle indicator and text color). The Semantics node does not set 'selected: isSelected', so screen reader users cannot tell which category is currently selected.

violations.type: Custom interactive control missing semantic action
violations.explanation: The Semantics wrapper declares button: true but has no onTap handler. The tap action comes only from the GestureDetector, so it may not be reliably exposed as an activation action on the button node. Setting onTap on Semantics, or using InkWell or TextButton, would ensure the action is exposed on the button itself.

GestureDetector is not keyboard focusable and cannot be activated with Enter or Space. This makes the control inaccessible to keyboard and switch users. Use a Material button or InkWell, or add Focus with keyboard activation.
